title: CoEvolve: Counterfactual-Guided Co-Evolution of Memory and Collaboration in Multi-Agent Systems
abstract: arXiv:2610.33539v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language model (LLM)-based multi-agent systems have demonstrated remarkable capabilities across diverse tasks. Yet their memory and collaboration architectures often remain static, constraining continued adaptation and improvement over time. Recent work addresses this limitation by evolving memory or collaboration based on interaction experience. However, updates to these interdependent components are not necessarily aligned: an evolved workflow may require experience that memory does not provide, while evolved memory may encode guidance that the workflow cannot use. translated_title: CoEvolve：多智能体系统中记忆与协作的反事实引导协同演化
translated_abstract: 基于大语言模型（LLM）的多智能体系统在各类任务中展现出卓越能力。然而，其记忆与协作架构往往保持静态，限制了系统随时间的持续适应与改进。近期工作通过基于交互经验来演化记忆或协作以解决这一局限，但这些相互依赖组件的更新未必是对齐的：演化后的工作流可能需要记忆未能提供的经验，而演化后的记忆可能编码了工作流无法利用的指导信息。为解决这一问题，我们提出 CoEvolve，一个以技能为中心的记忆与协作对齐演化框架。CoEvolve 将可重用的局部协作模式表示为技能，从而把不断演化的协作决策与其支撑记忆关联起来。它进一步通过对比原始轨迹与反事实轨迹来识别局部演化信号，从而协调记忆与协作的同步更新（摘要在此处被截断）。
tldr: 提出 CoEvolve 框架，将可复用协作模式表示为技能并利用原始与反事实轨迹对比产生演化信号，实现多智能体系统中记忆与协作的对齐协同演化。
en_tdlr: CoEvolve is a skill-centered framework that aligns the co-evolution of memory and collaboration in LLM-based multi-agent systems by representing reusable collaboration patterns as skills and using counterfactual trajectory comparisons to generate local evolution signals.
